notes_for_editor: Thinnest of the three. Two WebSearch queries and about six reads found no build date, staffing history or removal date for the Whitehouse tower, so the story is short and only covers the register record, the forest setting and the alternate name. The register places the tower in Maumee State Forest; the Oak Openings Preserve is a separate Toledo Metroparks property nearby and is not named as the site's manager. Coordinates differ slightly between sources (register 41.531667, -83.854722; association list 41.53155, -83.85487), under about 20 m apart. Access unknown. Brief checks: elevation 209 m and registration match; the brief's county and agency are correct. No corrections. Story body is about 127 words, just above the floor, and the editor may want to hold it until a better source turns up.
